title: The Missing Ring, Part 4
description: The Missing Ring, Part 4 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Chairman Manchair

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go anywhere within Upper MutantMania and shake down the locals until they give up the stools and buckets. Bring the stools and buckets to Chairman Manchair in the All-Amateur Assault off MutantMania's Level 3.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Chairman Manchair

Repeatable: No

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go anywhere within Upper MutantMania and shake down the locals until they give up the stools and buckets. Bring the stools and buckets to Chairman Manchair in the All-Amateur Assault off MutantMania's Level 3.

Offer:

Nelly Virago, here. Ace reporter for MutantMania Monthly Magazine. You did a great job tracking down the stolen All-Amateur Assault Polyhedral Circle Pan-Community Project Committee fight ring posts and ropes, but the story's not done quite yet. No, this story needs a hook. A human interest angle.

I know! At best, the completed fight ring is a place to work, but it can be more than that. Retrieve the missing stools and buckets, and it will feel like a home. A home for the competitors to sit and spit. Now that's a story my readers can empathize with!

Turn-in:

Od's bodkins! Ye be a sight for sore eyes! With these stools and buckets, we now be set for our first official fight. Just in time, too. Our old ring was gettin' a bit old in the tooth. Make sure you sign up! Cheers!

Objectives:

  • Fight Ring Stools ×2
  • Fight Ring Buckets ×2

Client level range: 81–100
